text_block_list.text:
Today is the day Каррен Тян starts
seriously
training for the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She shows real ability as a sprinter.
However, she
still spends much of her
training time on social
media, so it's
impossible to tell how serious she is

about racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When I ask her again about her future
goals, she
says she wants everyone to
know about "Cute
Curren." But when I
ask for her racing goals, she
says she
doesn't have any.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: She does, however, show some interest in the Triple Tiara. This might be difficult considering her distance aptitude, but I'm sure she has a plan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What are Каррен Тян's true intentions?
I'm
already being led around by the nose
as our days
of chasing cuteness begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
